interpretation.sourceShapeScope: The shape guard states the canonical source-command envelopes expected by this retained LKEY trajectory and its caller. It does not assert that RankedWorkshop universally rewrites arbitrary foreign commands: the source family copies what it receives.
interpretation.preservedOutcome: The retained trajectory remains 25 actions, two completed levels and an unresolved third-level frontier. A successful partial regression would preserve that outcome; it would not establish a third-level success.
